mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact finite checks of reference-center kinetic determinant, elimination of uniform field, original complex positive-square identity, nonuniversal-charge dipole coefficient, and target restoring derivative residual.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q and Q(i), exact Python Fraction arithmetic
mathematics.conventions: U=A*x, acceleration=-A, r=x1-x2, all inertial masses and reference weights positive; gamma/m ratios explicitly separate in loophole check.
inputs: Original-potential square: daughter mass {1,3/2}, source/daughter mass ratio {5/2,3}, gs {-2,0,3/5}, lambda_rep {1/7,2}, four rational-complex values per field.
Nonuniversal ratio grid eta1 {1,2}, eta2 {1,3}; target a0 {1,3/2}, K {1/3,2}, u/a0 {1/10,1/2,9/10}.
non_claims: The finite grid is not proof for arbitrary masses; the analytic note supplies universal identities.
No existence theorem for a bound state, droplet, crystal or quantum phase is numerically tested.
No strong-self-gravity, global GR or continuum quantum-field claim is tested.
